name: BottomNavigation
purpose: Style a short, stable set of primary compact-application destinations with active state and label-visibility recipes.
useWhen: A compact application needs a small fixed set of primary destinations at the bottom edge.

avoidWhen.condition: Navigation is longer, grouped, top-level disclosure navigation, or local panel switching.

composition: Place named Items with unique values inside Root; provide href for destinations and include text labels even when the selected visual recipe hides them.

rules.statement: Keep every icon destination's text accessible in every label-visibility mode.
When fixed or sticky, coordinate application content and safe-area spacing outside the component.
Load styles.css or core.css plus bottom-navigation.css.

commonMistakes.mistake: Using BottomNavigation as a generic mobile menu or removing labels from the DOM.
commonMistakes.correction: Use Drawer/NavList for a menu and preserve each Item label.

validation: Check active, disabled, label visibility, safe areas, narrow widths, touch targets, focus, and RTL.
Confirm URL destinations render links and CSS is loaded.
